text:
### Verification Checklist  
- [ ] Document received (note date)
- [ ] Document type identified
- [ ] Document date within acceptable range (usually 3 months)
- [ ] Customer name on document matches account
- [ ] Address on document matches new address provided
- [ ] Document is original or certified copy (not photocopy)
- [ ] No signs of tampering
- [ ] Document legibility sufficient to read
- [ ] Verified by second staff member (QA check)
name: Chunk 22/52

raw_entities.name: Address Verification Process
raw_entities.description: An operational procedure to verify a customer's identity and address through the review of submitted documentation. The process ensures document validity, consistency with account records, and quality assurance through a secondary review.
context: Verification Checklist
Address on document matches new address provided
Verified by second staff member (QA check)

raw_entities.name: Document Receipt and Dating
raw_entities.description: The initial step of the verification process where the document is received and the date of receipt is noted for the record.
context: Document received (note date)

raw_entities.name: Document Type Identification
raw_entities.description: The action of identifying the specific type of identification or address document provided by the customer.
context: Document type identified

raw_entities.name: Document Date Validity Check
raw_entities.description: A check to ensure the document date falls within the acceptable range, which is typically defined as within the last 3 months.
context: Document date within acceptable range (usually 3 months)

raw_entities.name: Customer Name Matching
aliases: Customer name on document matches account
raw_entities.description: The process of verifying that the name appearing on the submitted document is identical to the name held on the bank account.
context: Customer name on document matches account

raw_entities.name: Address Consistency Verification
aliases: Address on document matches new address provided
raw_entities.description: A step to confirm that the address displayed on the provided document matches the new address the customer is requesting to update.
context: Address on document matches new address provided

raw_entities.name: Document Authenticity and Format Check
aliases: Document is original or certified copy
raw_entities.description: A check to ensure the document is either an original or a certified copy, specifically excluding standard photocopies.
context: Document is original or certified copy (not photocopy)

raw_entities.name: Tamper Evidence Inspection
raw_entities.description: A visual inspection of the document to ensure there are no signs of alteration or tampering.
context: No signs of tampering

raw_entities.name: Legibility Assessment
raw_entities.description: A check to ensure the quality and clarity of the document are sufficient for the information to be read accurately.
context: Document legibility sufficient to read

raw_entities.name: Secondary Staff Quality Assurance Check
raw_entities.description: A mandatory four-eyes review where a second staff member verifies the checklist to ensure the verification was performed correctly.
context: Verified by second staff member (QA check)

raw_entities.name: Primary Verifying Staff
raw_entities.description: The staff member responsible for conducting the initial document review and completing the verification checklist.
context: Document received (note date)
Verified by second staff member

raw_entities.name: QA Verifying Staff
raw_entities.description: The second staff member responsible for performing the quality assurance check to verify the primary staff member's work.
context: Verified by second staff member (QA check)

raw_entities.name: Document Validity Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision point based on the verification checklist; if any item (date, name, address, authenticity) fails, the document is rejected.
context: Document date within acceptable range
Customer name on document matches account
No signs of tampering

raw_entities.name: Address Verification Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: The formal control gate ensuring all document verification requirements are satisfied before a change of address can be processed in the system.
context: Verification Checklist
Verified by second staff member (QA check)

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The bank customer whose identity and new address are being verified via the submitted documentation.
context: Customer name on document matches account

raw_entities.name: New Address
raw_entities.description: The new residential or business address provided by the customer that must be verified against a supporting document.
context: Address on document matches new address provided
